description: E212 s0, tests only: a synthetic source-rules document (E211's format) approving the two synthetic store datasets, so the store's fixtures never need a real dataset id. It refuses one synthetic dataset id and one synthetic record, binds one synthetic record to one host, and lists E211's SPDX identifiers. Production readers use samples/v1/source-rules.json.
